decision_needed.question: Insurance Fund 'Other Receipts Interfund Transfers' 5,356,069 is labelled as interfund transfers but the statement counts it as Other receipts, not in transfers in/out. Is it revenue (e.g. charges to other funds) or a transfer? Evidence on p3: transfers in and out both total 6,508,776 without it, and the Insurance Fund spends it as Personal Service/Operating Expense (general government), so the paying funds appear to have booked it as spending (internal insurance charges), which supports revenue; but the printed label says interfund transfers.
decision_needed.recorded_as: receipts, category other (inside the 15,703,241 Other line)

notes: Cash-basis county; all funds governmental, no business-type funds, so business_type null. Receipts/disbursements from Total Government Funds column p3. Printed Property/Motor Vehicle Taxes split using p1 statement of activities general receipts (property 23,724,581 + motor vehicle 2,441,485 = 26,166,066). Printed 'Other' 56,535,494 includes Courthouse Project bond proceeds 40,832,253 (p7), moved to debt_proceeds; remainder 15,703,241 split by fund column using the fund schedules (p4, p6, p7, p9) into inheritance tax, fees/charges, licenses, interlocal, lottery, special assessments, in-lieu taxes, reimbursements, sale of assets, federal grants, Insurance Fund interfund charges (other, decision_needed) and an unexplained remainder (other). State 10,533,599 split: nonmajor lodging tax 1,371,078 and tribal gaming tax 1,009,504 (p9) taken out; the remainder is state aid. General Fund 'Total Expenditures' (p5) is matched to the p10 department lines via includes_schedules. Printed total receipts includes debt_proceeds. Beginning/ending cash = beginning/ending fund balances rolled forward on p3 (84,355,089 ending equals total fund balances; balance sheet total assets 85,580,368 includes 1,225,279 liabilities held as cash). Ending investments 2,037,844 = certificates of deposit, informational. Balance sheet is governmental funds cash-basis (p2); no government-wide net position statement beyond p1 activities. Detail: General Fund revenue from budget schedule p4; General Fund spending from the more detailed department-by-object schedule p10 (not double counted with p5 function lines; budget amounts by department not recorded by object); the p10 memo total includes 2,562,009 transfers in the Personal Service/Interfund column, recorded as other financing instead (see p5 Transfers Out). Major funds from p6-7; Courthouse Project Other 1,390,062 split into interest 621,199 (p3) and remainder. Nonmajor funds recorded via Total Nonmajor column p9 (30+ funds); p8 left-half combining columns not recorded separately. Capital Outlay/Operating Expense/Personal Service mapped to equipment purchases or construction/not itemized/salaries and wages (personal service may include benefits). Transfers in/out each 6,508,776 balance. p11 (tax certified analysis) has no cash-flow data. Read pages 1-11 of 11.
